subject: Updated MAP & timeline — Slate Platform opportunity (pilot + procurement timing)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@slateplatform.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@slateplatform.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft and proposed milestones

Samira / Tom — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

Summary of needs
- Pilot (3 weeks) to validate latency/cost on your core workflows
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence + network requirements
- Integration: embeddings+reranking for search and a small chat surface

Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (Slate_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and a target close of 2027-06-30 assuming procurement proceeds on the typical cadence you described. High-level milestones in the draft:
1) Pilot scoping & sign-off (owner: Slate) — target: 2027-05-28
2) Pilot run + results review (owner: Slate/Redwood) — target: 2027-06-14
3) Contract SOW and pricing sign-off (owner: Redwood sales / Slate procurement) — target: 2027-06-24
4) Production cutover plan (owner: Slate eng / Redwood eng) — target: 2027-06-30

Dependencies / asks from Slate
- Procurement timeline and procurement approver list
- Completion of security questionnaire (we offered to provide a pre-populated trellis)
- Access to a small dataset for pilot (anonymized)

If the targets above look reasonable, can you confirm owners and any blackout dates? If procurement needs a different cadence please let me know; we can propose an interim hosted pilot to keep momentum.

Next steps
- You: confirm procurement approver + preferred pilot start window
- Us: iterate MAP and SOW after your confirmation (I’ve included Monica to own the SOW and Karthik to coordinate security artifacts)

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: Slate_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Samira Khan <skhan@slateplatform.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@slateplatform.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft and proposed milestones

Thanks Vivek — useful summary. Quick update from my side after an internal sync with procurement and security: we need to move the target close out to mid-August. Short rationale:
- Procurement has a monthly cadence; their next internal approval window is the first week of August (contracts signed by ~Aug 10–15)
- Security asked for a deeper run at our network diagram and a short third-party risk assessment; that will push the pilot start by ~2–3 weeks

Proposed adjustments I'd like you to consider in the MAP:
- New target close: 2027-08-15
- Pilot: shift start to the week of 2027-07-12, run to ~07-30, then review
- Keep SOW deliverables the same, but move contract signature task to Aug 10–15

I'm attaching a short procurement timeline and my proposed approver list for transparency. Also — can Redwood provide an interim hosted pilot option so we can validate technical fit without waiting on on-prem provisioning? That would reduce program risk.

Thanks — Samira

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 2:05 PM Vivek Kulkarni <viveve@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samira / Tom — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:...

attachments: Procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Slate Platform timeline shift — proposed MAP updates and mitigations

Folks — Samira pushed their close to ~Aug 15 and asked about an interim hosted pilot. Risks / action items:
- Risk: if contract signature slips beyond July we lose the initial pricing tier they negotiated (discount window ends 07/31).
- Security needs an expanded artifact pack (network diagram + third-party assessment) — Karthik, can you own collection & delivery?
- Monica, please prepare an SOW skeleton aligned to the shifted milestones and include a hosted-pilot option (90-day trial on hosted infra) so we can keep the pilot in June/July if they agree.

Proposed MAP edits (I’ll push these as Slate_MAP_v2):
- New target close: 2027-08-15 (per customer)
- Add parallel hosted pilot option: start 2027-07-01 (contingent on sign-off by 2027-05-31 on pilot scope)
- Move contract sign-off to Aug 10–15 but add a pricing hold note that requires verbal agreement by 07/22 to retain pricing tier

Please confirm you own the bullets above and I’ll update the MAP & SOW drafts. Attaching my working files: Slate_MAP_v2.xlsx and Hosted_Pilot_Proposal.docx.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Slate MAP v2 (updated milestones + mitigation plan) — please review & confirm

Samira / Tom — attached is the updated MAP (Slate_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a light SOW draft (SOW_draft_v1.pdf) reflecting the timeline you requested plus a parallel hosted pilot option to de-risk the program. Key changes summarized below:
- Target close: 2027-08-15 (moved per procurement request)
- Hosted pilot (optional): proposed start 2027-07-01, 3-week run; scope: search reranking + chat latency test; owner: Slate eng (pilot data) / Redwood eng (run & monitoring)
- Security artifacts: Karthik will deliver a network diagram + SOC/third-party pack by 2027-06-07
- Pricing hold: we can hold the proposed pricing through 2027-07-22 contingent on a verbal go/no-go. After that date we may need to revisit list pricing

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Samira: please confirm by 2027-05-31 whether you want the hosted pilot path (we'll schedule an 30-minute scoping call on 2027-06-02 if yes)
2) Tom: please share the procurement approver emails so Monica can align the SOW and contract templates
3) Karthik: confirm you'll own the security artifact pack and target delivery date

If everyone confirms, we'll treat Slate_MAP_v2 as the working MAP and I'll create a short change log. Thanks for the quick turn — aim to keep momentum even with the shifted procurement window.

Best — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
